intro: Trying to find South Carolina scholarships for high school students in the USA usually means sorting through programs that do not all ask for the same things. In this filtered slice, you can compare listings tied to South Carolina while keeping your search focused on high school applicants. The rows below span areas such as education, humanities, STEM, and miscellaneous topics, so it is worth scanning beyond one subject label. Awards vary by listing, deadlines differ by program, and requirements can be lighter for some opportunities than others. If you plan to apply for scholarships in South Carolina for the upcoming cycle, check each row closely and review the latest details on the provider application path before you decide where to spend time.

faq.question: Can I compare award amounts and deadlines across these South Carolina high school scholarships?

faq.question: Are these scholarships only for high school seniors in South Carolina?
faq.answer: Not always. While this filter is centered on High School and South Carolina, sample study levels in the catalog include high school senior and high school freshman, so check each listing carefully before you apply.

faq.question: Do all programs here require an essay or a long application?
